projects.subtitle: Martian Rover, AESS Rover Challenge Contest
bullets: This project was a contest where some friends and I participated. The AESS organized a

where we had to build a rover that could plant a seed of corn in a pot. The rover had to be controlled remotely and had to be able to navigate through natural obstacles. It was supposed to be implemented for real applications in agricultural Colombian farms as prototype.
I write the firmware to Motion control, the communication via I2C, UART and Traditional Serial protocols in C++ and Python. We used a variantion of Rasberry Pi called Orange Pi.

projects.subtitle: JobScraping
bullets: Sometimes when we got fired or we are looking for a job, we need to search for job offers in different websites. This project is a web scraper that allows you to search for job offers in different websites at the same time. It is a simple project that I created to help me find a job when I was looking for one.
Also i was able to extract, transform and load the data saved in a parquet towards an Analytics tool like PowerBI or Tableau. I build a
function in my personal
